instruction: Draft a reply to Marco saying we can't do 20% off, but don't send it. I want to read it first.
final_text:
I saved a reply to Marco Bianchi (marco@verdant.example) as a draft in the "Re: Renewal pricing" thread. I haven't sent it.

He asked for 20% off in exchange for a two-year commitment. The draft thanks him and says we can't do 20%. It says the quote we sent is already our best renewal pricing. It also offers a call to talk through the two-year option.

The line about the quote being our best pricing is my wording, since I had no other context on the pricing. Please check that it's accurate before you send. The draft also doesn't offer a smaller discount. If you'd like to counter with one, tell me the number and I'll add it.

input.subject: Re: Renewal pricing
input.body:
Hi Marco,

Thanks for getting back to me, and for considering a two-year commitment. We really value working with Verdant.

Unfortunately we can't do 20% off. The quote we sent is already our best pricing for the renewal, so I don't have room to move that far.

I'm happy to talk through the two-year option and see if there's something else that would work for you. Let me know if a quick call would help.

Best,
Sam
